cavalry.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished wide panoramic 2.45:1 landscape illustration for a grand-strategy game unit card, no panels. Match the existing Ashborn infantry painting: late medieval dark fantasy oil painting, realistic textured brushwork, overcast grey sky, cold sea spray, black volcanic rock shoreline, jagged basalt islands and one smoking volcano with a thin lava glow in the background, restrained natural colors. Ashborn goblins are short, wiry, ugly adults with muted olive green skin, very long sideways pointed ears with small iron rings, long hooked noses, amber eyes, small sharp teeth and a scowl. They wear ragged patchwork brown cloth hoods, worn leather wraps, rope bindings and scavenged rusty iron. Composition: exactly three main subjects side by side, one centered in each vertical third of the image (left, middle, right), each readable on its own when the image is cropped into three tall portrait frames; heads in the upper half, nothing important at the far edges. Smaller goblin troops faded in the misty background. No humans, no writing or text, no logos, no modern objects, no watermark. Goblin cavalry: three goblin riders charging along the surf toward the viewer, each mounted on a shaggy, wild-eyed dark island pony far too big for them. Left rider levels a rusty barbed lance with a tattered brown pennant; middle rider wears a dented riveted iron kettle helm and mail scraps over leather, swinging a notched cleaver, round patched shield strapped to his arm; right rider hunches low with a short spear and rope reins. Rope-and-leather tack, mismatched scavenged barding plates, sea water splashing under hooves.
